title: Same notes, different positions
summary: Explore one note, then play the same scale in two regions.
goal: Keep the sounding notes and their octaves while changing the fingering.
body: Complete Major scale first. Moving to another region changes where you play, while the key and sounding pitches stay the same. A region begins near its named fret; the first note need not be on that fret. Choose a comfortable tempo. Each Practice button starts a separate performance. The app assesses pitch and timing; only you can confirm which fingering you used.

hear-note.title: 1. Find the same note elsewhere
hear-note.body: Listen to {{first}}, then choose another available region. Play {{positions}}. Compare its pitch with the original; keep the same octave.

explore-scale.title: 2. Explore the scale
explore-scale.body: Try the available choices and compare the paths: {{positions}}. The complete scale must fit the region. Read the tab before starting.

play-original.title: 3. Perform the original fingering
play-original.body: Use {{positionLabel}}: {{positions}}. Complete this attempt before moving to the next step.

play-seven.title: 4. Perform near fret seven
play-seven.body: Use {{positionLabel}}: {{positions}}. This window is six frets wide to include the adjusted low-string fingering in Drop tunings. If the activity is unavailable on your instrument, return to exploration or change the instrument settings.

reflect.title: 5. Compare your attempts
reflect.body: Check pitch and timing in History, and reflect on how the two fingerings felt. Scores do not prove which string, fret or finger you used. A self-confirmation records your own report.
